proof_body:
by
  intro R _ _ _ x
  by_cases hx : IsUnit x
  · exact Or.inl hx
  · right
    have hm : x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := hx
    rw [← IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal ⊥ bot_ne_top] at hm
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsArtinianRing.isNilpotent_jacobson_bot (R := R)
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    have := Ideal.pow_mem_pow hm n
    rw [hn] at this
    simpa using this
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (x : R), IsUnit x ∨ IsNilpotent x
